title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Training Basis — The Fee Base a Service Credit Is Struck On
content:
**What figure is the fee base of a service credit on a workplace cafe management contract?**

Where three or more management fee invoices stand on the contract in the three months up to the day the credit is worked out and the management fee most recently invoiced stands above the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force, the fee base is the management fee most recently invoiced. Where three or more management fee invoices stand on the contract in the three months up to the day the credit is worked out and the management fee most recently invoiced stands at or below the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force, the fee base is the mean of the management fees invoiced over those three months, rounded to the nearest cent. Where fewer than three management fee invoices stand over those three months, the fee base is the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force.

**What is counted over the three months?**

The count is of management fee invoices standing on the contract's ledger for a site under the Workplace Cafe Management Program over the 3 months up to the day the credit is worked out, and the figure compared is the management fee most recently invoiced on that contract.

**Which condition answers which fee base?**

| Management fee invoices standing over the three months | The management fee most recently invoiced | Fee base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | above the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force | the management fee most recently invoiced |
| 3 or more | at or below the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force | the mean of the management fees invoiced over those three months, rounded to the nearest cent |
| fewer than 3 | not read | the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force |

**Where does the boundary sit?**

A management fee most recently invoiced that stands at exactly the monthly management fee printed against the service model in force is at that figure and not above it, so the mean of the management fees invoiced over those three months answers, rounded to the nearest cent.

**How does that read on hypothetical invoicing?**

Take a contract hypothetically showing 3 management fee invoices over those three months of 5000.00 USD, 5000.00 USD and 5300.00 USD, against a monthly management fee printed for its service model of 5000.00 USD: the management fee most recently invoiced, 5300.00 USD, stands above that printed figure, so the fee base is 5300.00 USD. Had those three invoices hypothetically been 5000.00 USD, 4700.00 USD and 4400.00 USD, the fee base would be the mean of the three, 4700.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent.
